title: Podcast Scraper — Deploys (#803)
description: Deploys from the deploy events that deploy-prod.yml and the player/operator/config deploy workflows push to VictoriaLogs through scripts/ops/emit_ops_event.sh (ops_event/v1: event_type=deploy, status, surface, sha, triggered_by). duration_ms is only set by the prod operator deploy, so the duration panel covers those. Retention is 30 days. MTTR (failed -> next success) is not shown: it needs correlation a single LogsQL panel cannot express.

targets.expr: app:podcast_scraper AND event_type:deploy AND schema:"ops_event/v1" | stats count() deploys
app:podcast_scraper AND event_type:deploy AND schema:"ops_event/v1" | stats count() total, count() if (status:!success) failed | math failed / total failure_rate | fields failure_rate

panels.title: p95 deploy duration (30d, ms)
panels.description: Only the prod operator deploy records duration_ms.

targets.expr: app:podcast_scraper AND event_type:deploy AND schema:"ops_event/v1" AND duration_ms:>0 | stats quantile(0.95, duration_ms) p95_ms
app:podcast_scraper AND event_type:deploy AND schema:"ops_event/v1" | stats by (status) count() deploys
